description: Defines a test server class (QuicTestServer) for the QUIC protocol, including factory classes for sessions, streams, and crypto streams, as well as a test session class (ImmediateGoAwaySession). It provides mechanisms for creating custom QUIC server sessions and streams for testing purposes.

classes.name: QuicTestServer
classes.description: A test server class derived from QuicServer, with factory methods for creating custom sessions, streams, and crypto streams, and the ability to override event loop creation.

classes.name: SessionFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating QuicServerSessionBase instances.

classes.name: StreamFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating QuicSimpleServerStream instances.

classes.name: CryptoStreamFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating QuicCryptoServerStreamBase instances.

classes.name: ImmediateGoAwaySession
classes.description: A test session that sends a GOAWAY frame immediately upon creation, used for testing server behavior.

methods.name: CreateQuicDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a custom dispatcher for the server.

methods.name: SetCryptoStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom crypto stream factory.

methods.name: SetEventLoopFactory
methods.description: Overrides the default event loop factory.

methods.name: CreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates a new event loop instance.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Overrides to send GOAWAY frame immediately.
